-- EFFECT MISMATCH ---------------------------------- main.fango

`logAll` performs `Console`, which its annotation does not list.

3| logAll : List String -> List ()
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

This performs it:

4| logAll items = List.map { item -> print item } items
                                     ^^^^^^^^^^

The annotation says:

    List String -> List ()

but the body needs:

    List String ->{Console} List ()
